title: sts2.fun statistics
description:
Automatically uploads your finished Slay the Spire 2 runs to [url=https://sts2.fun]sts2.fun[/url], the community stats site (card, relic, ancient and event statistics, including causal win-rate effects).

[b]What it does[/b]
[list]
[*]When you start the game and after each run, it checks which of your run files sts2.fun doesn't have yet and uploads those.
[*]Shows your sts2.fun account name on the main menu; click it to open your player page.
[/list]

[b]What it sends[/b]
Your .run files (the game's run history). For runs that end while the mod is installed, also what the .run file leaves out: the full shop stock with prices and what you bought, every event option you were shown (including locked ones) and which you chose, and every potion gained, used or discarded. Plus the list of mods that were loaded (names and versions), so runs played with gameplay-changing mods are left out of the statistics. Nothing else is read or sent. It does not affect gameplay.

[b]Save profile[/b]
Since v0.113 the game switches to a separate, empty "modded" save profile as soon as any mod is loaded. When every loaded mod is marked as not affecting gameplay, this mod keeps you on your normal profile. Gameplay mods still get the separate profile.

[b]Turning it off[/b]
Set "Enabled": false in sts2fun_stats/config.json in the game's user data folder, or unsubscribe.

Source code: https://github.com/Deleetdk/sts2fun-stats
changeNote: Works on the v0.113 public beta (and still on stable): fixes the mod not starting after the patch. Keeps your normal save profile when only non-gameplay mods are loaded. Also records shop stock and purchases, event options and potions for each run.
